name: Yawata (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Yawata city emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing two facing stylised doves.
history: Municipal flag of Yawata, a city in Kyoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1964.

features.role: Yawata city emblem — an outlined ring enclosing two facing stylised doves
